headline: Healthcare Global Enterprises: Q1 FY2027 Monitoring Agency Report on Rights Issue Proceeds Utilization
sum: HCG filed its Q1 FY2027 monitoring agency report under SEBI regulations confirming compliance with rights issue proceeds utilization requirements. CARE Ratings Limited, appointed as monitoring agency, issued the report for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 pursuant to SEBI's capital issuance and listing disclosure norms.
detail: Healthcare Global Enterprises Limited, a listed healthcare services provider headquartered in Bengaluru, submitted its quarterly monitoring agency report to the NSE in compliance with SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (Regulation 32(6)) and SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018 (Regulation 82(4)). The report, issued by independent monitoring agency CARE Ratings Limited, covers the three-month period ended 30 June 2026 and certifies the utilization of proceeds from a rights issue. Such reports are mandatory for listed issuers following a rights offering to ensure capital raised is deployed in accordance with the stated objects of the issue.
